keyword: order high flow hydraulic sprayer 7 m3/h

title.en: Output is 7 m³/h is the High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine cell under “Natural Draft Head”
title.zh: 「输送量是 7 m³/h。」是「自然 通风 扬程」下面的大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h格子

description.en: High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Output is 7 m³/h 11/15 kW is the motor pair
description.zh: 大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h见 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine。输送量是 7 m³/h。这张喷涂页写明 380 V。

h1.en: Keep High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine under “Natural Draft Pressure” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「自然 通风 压力」下保留大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine. The row to open is /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Output is 7 m³/h. 11/15 kW is the motor pair. This 7 m³/h cell is a sprayer. This sprayer page states 380 V. 150 m / 70 m belongs to this page. The 5 m³/h page prints 100 m / 50 m. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h as a trailer. Only if you are matching 7.5/9 kW and 5 m³/h. The diesel concrete sprayer is the ≤6 mm page. The selection note for these hydraulic rows says ≤8 mm. The 5 m³/h hydraulic page prints 7.5/9 kW and 100 m / 50 m. Particle size on the selection note for this hydraulic family is ≤8 mm. If the motors you can feed are 11/15 kW and the output cell you are matching is 7 m³/h, send /en/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/ to /en/contact/. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the high-flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine at 380 V, 11/15 kW, dual motor, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m / 70 m and hose 38/51 mm. The section title “Natural Draft Head” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h的数字。要打开的行是 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine。输送量是 7 m³/h。这张喷涂页写明 380 V。11/15 kW 是电机一对。这个 7 m³/h 是喷涂机。这些液压行的选型说明写 ≤8 mm。≤6 mm 是柴油混凝土喷涂机那一页。150 m / 70 m 属于这一页。电动15作为拖泵印 8–10 m³/h。选型说明里这一液压系列的粒径是 ≤8 mm。5 m³/h 那一页印 100 m / 50 m。只有你在对照 7.5/9 kW 和 5 m³/h 时才订。5 m³/h 的液压页印 7.5/9 kW 和 100 m / 50 m。河北品锦机械（邢台）把大流量液压混凝土喷涂机印成 380 V、11/15 kW、双电机、7 m³/h、8 MPa、150 m / 70 m、软管 38/51 mm。如果你能供给的电机是 11/15 kW，并且对照的输送量格是 7 m³/h，请把 /zh/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/ 发到 /zh/contact/。节标题「自然 通风 扬程」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

heading.zh: 自然 通风 扬程

body.en: High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine is unchanged by the heading “Natural Draft Head”. Output is 7 m³/h. 150 m / 70 m belongs to this page. The diesel concrete sprayer is the ≤6 mm page. If the motors you can feed are 11/15 kW and the output cell you are matching is 7 m³/h, send /en/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/ to /en/contact/.
body.zh: 大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h不因标题「自然 通风 扬程」而改动。输送量是 7 m³/h。150 m / 70 m 属于这一页。≤6 mm 是柴油混凝土喷涂机那一页。河北品锦机械（邢台）把大流量液压混凝土喷涂机印成 380 V、11/15 kW、双电机、7 m³/h、8 MPa、150 m / 70 m、软管 38/51 mm。

heading.zh: 自然 通风 压力

body.en: This section is titled “Natural Draft Pressure”. High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine still prints the cells below. 11/15 kW is the motor pair. The 5 m³/h page prints 100 m / 50 m. The selection note for these hydraulic rows says ≤8 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the high-flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine at 380 V, 11/15 kW, dual motor, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m / 70 m and hose 38/51 mm.
body.zh: 本节标题是「自然 通风 压力」。大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h下面这些格子仍是印出来的。11/15 kW 是电机一对。5 m³/h 那一页印 100 m / 50 m。这些液压行的选型说明写 ≤8 mm。如果你能供给的电机是 11/15 kW，并且对照的输送量格是 7 m³/h，请把 /zh/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/ 发到 /zh/contact/。

body.en: Under “Density and Temperature”, High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine contributes only the printed cells in this part. This 7 m³/h cell is a sprayer. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h as a trailer. The 5 m³/h hydraulic page prints 7.5/9 kW and 100 m / 50 m.
body.zh: 在「密度与温度」下，大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h这一节只放已印出的格子。这个 7 m³/h 是喷涂机。电动15作为拖泵印 8–10 m³/h。5 m³/h 的液压页印 7.5/9 kW 和 100 m / 50 m。

heading.zh: 自然 通风 压力 计算器

body.en: “Natural Draft Pressure Calculator” titles this part of the High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine note. The figures stay the printed ones. This sprayer page states 380 V. Only if you are matching 7.5/9 kW and 5 m³/h. Particle size on the selection note for this hydraulic family is ≤8 mm. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/natural-draught-ventilation-d_122.html.
body.zh: 「自然 通风 压力 计算器」是大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。这张喷涂页写明 380 V。只有你在对照 7.5/9 kW 和 5 m³/h 时才订。选型说明里这一液压系列的粒径是 ≤8 mm。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/natural-draught-ventilation-d_122.html。

question.en: Does “Natural Draft Head” replace Output is 7 m³/h?
question.zh: 「自然 通风 扬程」会替换「输送量是 7 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Output is 7 m³/h remains the printed wording for High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine.
answer.zh: 不会。输送量是 7 m³/h。仍是大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h已印的说法。

question.en: Where does 11/15 kW is the motor pair belong on the High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine row?
question.zh: 大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h这一行里，「这张喷涂页写明 380 V。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Natural Draft Pressure” add to High Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine?
question.zh: 「自然 通风 压力」给大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/natural-draught-ventilation-d_122.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/natural-draught-ventilation-d_122.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
